item.title: ClipFlair Newsletter – May 2012
item.dc:creator: admin
item.description:
ClipFlair is a European-funded project for foreign language learning through interactive revoicing and captioning of clips. The project’s main outputs include: » A web platform through which the users will be able to create, upload and access the revoicing and captioning activities. It will also support social-networking, offering Web 2.0 features (blogs, wikis, tags) that will enable users to share their work, form groups, cooperate, interact and rate activities
